nodes.description: Public uint256 start time used as the epoch schedule base in seigniorageOracle.
Public uint256 epoch counter incremented after every successful update() via SafeMath.add.
Address of the lower-sorted token of the Uniswap pair, copied from the pair in the constructor.
Address of the higher-sorted token of the Uniswap pair, copied from the pair in the constructor.
IUniswapV2Pair handle used for all external oracle price queries in update().
uint32 timestamp of the last cumulative price snapshot; subtracted to derive timeElapsed.
uint256 stored cumulative price of token0, subtracted from the freshly fetched cumulative value.
uint256 stored cumulative price of token1, subtracted from the freshly fetched cumulative value.
FixedPoint.uq112x112 time-weighted average price of token0 written by update() and read by consult().
FixedPoint.uq112x112 time-weighted average price of token1 written by update() and read by consult().
Constant 1 day period used together with epoch to compute the next epoch point.
Constructor that resolves the pair via UniswapV2Library.pairFor, performs several external pair calls, and seeds oracle state.
Modifier that requires now >= nextEpochPoint() before the body and increments epoch afterwards.
View function returning startTime + epoch * PERIOD, the gating timestamp of the epoch schedule.
External, unpermissioned function that fetches cumulative prices, computes the elapsed window and rewrites the TWAP state.
External view that returns amountOut by multiplying the stored average price by amountIn for a given token.
External pure passthrough to UniswapV2Library.pairFor for CREATE2 pair address derivation.
block.timestamp consumed as now inside the checkEpoch modifier and used as the oracle time source.
uint32 subtraction blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast where underflow/overflow wrapping is intentionally desired.
Division of cumulative price deltas by timeElapsed with unchecked subtraction and truncating uint224 cast.
External calls into the Uniswap pair (via UniswapV2OracleLibrary/IUniswapV2Pair) executed inside update().
update() is external and has no owner/role restriction, so any address may drive the oracle state machine once per period.
Constructor performs external calls (pairFor-derived pair.token0/token1/getReserves/price*CumulativeLast) on an arbitrarily supplied factory/token set.
Constructor parameter _factory: Uniswap factory address used for pair derivation.
Constructor parameter _tokenA: first token of the pair.
Constructor parameter _tokenB: second token of the pair.
Constructor parameter _startTime: initial epoch schedule timestamp written to startTime.
consult() parameter token: token whose average price is requested.
consult() parameter amountIn: size of the quote multiplied by the stored average price.
pairFor() parameter factory: factory address forwarded to UniswapV2Library.pairFor.
pairFor() parameter tokenA: first token forwarded to pair derivation.
pairFor() parameter tokenB: second token forwarded to pair derivation.
Constructor local _pair: the IUniswapV2Pair resolved from the factory, stored into state.
Constructor local reserve0 returned by getReserves(), used in the liquidity require.
Constructor local reserve1 returned by getReserves(), used in the liquidity require.
update() local price0Cumulative from currentCumulativePrices, the minuend of the price0 delta.
update() local price1Cumulative from currentCumulativePrices, the minuend of the price1 delta.
update() local blockTimestamp (uint32) returned by the oracle library for the elapsed calculation.
update() local uint32 timeElapsed = blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast, the divisor of the TWAP computation.
consult() return local amountOut decoded from the average price multiplied by amountIn.

edges.reason: block.timestamp (used as now) gates the checkEpoch modifier, creating a timestamp dependency on when epoch updates are allowed.
The checkEpoch modifier guards the execution of the external update() function.
The modifier calls nextEpochPoint() to evaluate its require condition.
After the modified body, the modifier writes epoch = epoch.add(1).
nextEpochPoint() reads startTime to compute the next epoch timestamp.
nextEpochPoint() reads the current epoch counter.
PERIOD constant scales the epoch counter in the next epoch point computation.
update() triggers external calls to the Uniswap pair while oracle state is being rewritten.
External pair/library calls return control into update() mid-state-transition (cross-contract callback surface).
update() computes timeElapsed via wrapping uint32 subtraction of timestamps.
blockTimestampLast is the subtrahend in the wrapping timeElapsed computation.
timeElapsed is the divisor of the cumulative price delta division.
update() divides cumulative price deltas by timeElapsed and truncates to uint224.
price0CumulativeLast is subtracted from the new cumulative price inside update().
price1CumulativeLast is subtracted from the new cumulative price inside update().
The computed average is written into price0Average.
The computed average is written into price1Average.
update() persists the freshly fetched price0Cumulative into price0CumulativeLast.
update() persists the freshly fetched price1Cumulative into price1CumulativeLast.
update() persists the observed blockTimestamp into blockTimestampLast.
The stored pair address is the target of the external cumulative-price calls.
update() is externally callable with no owner or role check, allowing anyone to advance the oracle each period.
consult() reads price0Average when the requested token equals token0.
consult() reads price1Average when the requested token equals token1.
consult() compares the caller-supplied token against token0.
consult() requires the caller-supplied token to equal token1 in the else branch.
The constructor makes multiple external calls to attacker-influenced pair/factory addresses before state is fully seeded.
External pair resolution yields the address stored in the pair state variable.
The constructor writes startTime from its input parameter.
The constructor copies _pair.token0() output into token0.
The constructor copies _pair.token1() output into token1.
The constructor seeds price0CumulativeLast from the pair's current cumulative price.
The constructor seeds price1CumulativeLast from the pair's current cumulative price.
The constructor sets blockTimestampLast from the pair's getReserves() response.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only feeds the pair derivation used by the constructor; normalize into the constructor node.
Constructor parameter _tokenA is only used for pair resolution inside the constructor.
Constructor parameter _tokenB is only used for pair resolution inside the constructor.
Constructor parameter _startTime is directly assigned to the startTime state variable in the constructor.
consult() parameter token only drives the token0/token1 branch selection in consult().
consult() parameter amountIn is only consumed by the average price multiplication in consult().
pairFor() parameter factory is only forwarded to UniswapV2Library.pairFor.
pairFor() parameter tokenA is only forwarded to the pair address derivation.
pairFor() parameter tokenB is only forwarded to the pair address derivation.
Local _pair exists only within the constructor to resolve and cache the pair state variable.
Local reserve0 only participates in the constructor liquidity require.
Local reserve1 only participates in the constructor liquidity require.
Local price0Cumulative only holds the freshly fetched value used to compute price0Average in update().
Local price1Cumulative only holds the freshly fetched value used to compute price1Average in update().
Local blockTimestamp only supplies the current timestamp used by update()'s elapsed calculation.
Local timeElapsed is the divisor of the unsafe cumulative delta division, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Local amountOut is merely the decoded return value of the consult() price computation.
